resolvedExactMigrationManifest.resolutionRule: Apply the complete semantic v4 /peopleV59 manifest, then replace only template_content_schema_version and every guard describing that field with the semantic and central v6 string correction. No other v4 field, key, index, RLS rule, guard or prohibition changes.

employmentContractSchemaVersionCorrectio.superseded: template_content_schema_version INTEGER NOT NULL and any positive-integer guard for this column
employmentContractSchemaVersionCorrectio.exactBinding: Stored value equals immutable PDX-001 payloadSchemaVersion and PDX-015 contentSchemaVersion byte-for-byte, with no numeric coercion, defaulting or case normalization.

sharedControls: ENABLE and FORCE row-level security on all four tables
USING and WITH CHECK tenant policy bound to dwp.tenant_id on all four tables
same-tenant foreign keys and the exact keys, indexes, period exclusions and immutable guards sealed in semantic v4
atomic employment-contract row, receipt result, audit pointer and XCON-026 outbox commit
clean People migration through V59 and V58-to-V59 upgrade verification
historical V1 through V58 checksum preservation
forbidden: a second V59 migration or any migration outside the exact path
any fifth table or new receipt, audit or outbox table
clear tax, bank, routing or dependent-profile values
data backfill, deletion or automatic privilege elevation

static: V59 is unique in People main and the exact leased path is the only new People migration.
V1 through V58 bytes and checksums remain unchanged.
The migration creates exactly the four sealed tables and resolves template_content_schema_version as TEXT with the exact v6 regular expression.
No new receipt, audit or outbox table is created.
database: real PostgreSQL clean People migration through V59
RLS missing-context and cross-tenant denial for all four tables
exact key, exclusion, lifecycle, immutability and restricted-value guards
valid and invalid template content schema version values
transaction rollback leaves no contract, receipt-success, audit-success or XCON-026 outbox partial write
verificationRequiredAfterActivation.unavailableDatabaseRule: Report BLOCKED, not PASS, if required real PostgreSQL verification cannot run.
verificationRequiredAfterActivation.targetedPolicy: Run the migration contract group and fresh/upgrade PostgreSQL group once; after a failure rerun only the smallest affected target. Do not run a repository-wide suite for this lease.

reservationSemantics: This document reserves only People main V59 and the exact path. It is not an active lease and grants no migration write, source write, test, commit or push authority. A later append-only active-lease successor must hash-bind a materialized clean backend worktree, and a separate executable start token must bind that successor and the owner packet.
invalidationConditions: People V59 or the exact leased path exists from another owner before the first authorized edit.
People main high-water differs from V58 at worktree materialization.
The planned backend worktree path or branch exists with a different head, tree, upstream or non-empty porcelain.
Any table, column, key, index, policy or guard outside the resolved exact manifest is required.
Any caller interprets template_content_schema_version as numeric or changes the v6 pattern/binding.
An existing migration must change, a second People migration is required or a data backfill becomes necessary.
